messages:
alex: Hey team — trying to flip a feature flag in staging via Console but getting a 403. I can open the same flag in prod fine. Anyone seen this before? Screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/console-403.png
samantha: @alex welcome! quick q — did you use your SSO (Okta) staging role or the temp console link? sometimes new hires get prod access before staging roles are provisioned :grimacing:
alex: I clicked the Console link from the onboarding doc (https://intranet.redwood/example/onboard). shows the flag page but when I click "Edit" it errors: `403 Forbidden — not authorized` in the UI. No option to request access on the page.
infra-team: Alex — can you run `curl -I -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.staging.redwood.ai/api/flags/FLAG_ID` and paste the headers (redact token)? might show which role is missing.
alex: paste: ```HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
content-type: application/json
x-request-id: zyx-12345
x-user-roles: readonly,dev
authorization: required
```
infra-team: aha `x-user-roles` shows `readonly,dev` so you don't have `console-admin` or `ff-admin`. we gate flag edits to `ff-admin` in staging for safety.
samantha: I asked PeopleOps to trigger the staging-admin role during onboarding but sometimes the automation misses new hires. @infra-team can you provision a short-lived grant? otherwise file a support request via #help-console and add `@eng-platform`.
devex-bot: New access request created: ticket #IN-7582 (auto) — assigned to eng-platform. ETA 24h. Link: https://issues.redwood.example/IN-7582 :robot_face:
rachael: tagging security — if we grant `ff-admin` make it time-limited (max 72h) and note audited action. Alex, don't use prod creds as a workaround.
james (eng-platform): I can do a quick patch. Granting `ff-admin:staging` to alex for 48h. Audit id: AUD-20260323-58. Will attach to ticket IN-7582.
james (eng-platform): done — you should see `ff-admin` in `x-user-roles` now. If not, `ctrl+shift+R` to clear Console cache or try incognito.
alex: confirmed — reran the curl, now: ```x-user-roles: readonly,dev,ff-admin``` and I could toggle the flag. Thank you!! :tada: 
samantha: woo! add a short note in the onboarding doc about the gap so PeopleOps can fix the automation?
alex: will do — pushed a tiny PR to the handbook: https://git.redwood.example/onboarding/patch-ff-role
rachael: leaving only the security note — please avoid copying prod feature configs into staging without a quick smoke test.
alex: noted. thanks everyone :pray:
